name: kuhn
description: Dev-only orchestrator for the Kuhn monorepo. Not a published package — each app (agent-backend, webapp) is still installed independently; this just provides one-command install and run.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,webapp -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix agent-backend run dev" "npm --prefix webapp run dev"
scripts.setup: npm --prefix agent-backend install && npm --prefix webapp install
